entries.34156c3a9790fdf0: It sells to customers through sales companies in Japan and overseas. entries.f100fe47443914b8: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,784,965 million, with external customer revenue comprising ¥4,638,342 million from automobiles, ¥141,667 million from aerospace and ¥4,956 million from other. Automobile revenue is recognized when vehicles are delivered, and aerospace revenue is recognized as construction work progresses.
entries.f849aa62acb79a9f: This business manufactures, sells and repairs aircraft, space-related equipment and their parts. Because it enters into contracts with customers, revenue is recognized according to the progress of construction work. Order intake for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥203,569 million, and order backlog was ¥707,464 million.
entries.ff92dd56c9937786: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥40,120 million, broken down into ¥32,086 million for automobiles, ¥3.5 billion for aerospace, ¥3,616 million for other and ¥918 million in adjustments. The securities report cites as factors behind the decline in automobile profit the impact of additional U.S. tariffs, environmental regulation-related expenses including losses on environmental regulatory credits, and the recording of BEV-related expenses.
